Context
-------
Read .github/copilot-instructions.md first.

Target: a single Ubuntu 22.04 or 24.04 VM. This produces the cluster the
whole demo runs on.

Objective
---------
Idempotent scripts that take a bare VM to a working K3S node with Cilium
as the CNI, kube-proxy replaced, Hubble and Tetragon enabled.

Deliverables
------------
- scripts/00-prereqs.sh   kernel modules, sysctls, /etc/hosts entries for
                          registry.lab.local and workshops.lab.local,
                          swap disabled
- scripts/10-k3s.sh       install K3S with networking disabled
- scripts/20-cilium.sh    helm install Cilium
- scripts/verify-cluster.sh

Requirements

K3S must be installed with:
  --flannel-backend=none
  --disable-network-policy
  --disable-kube-proxy
  --disable=traefik
  --disable=servicelb

Cilium must be installed with these values:
  kubeProxyReplacement=true
  k8sServiceHost=127.0.0.1
  k8sServicePort=6443
  hubble.relay.enabled=true
  hubble.ui.enabled=true
  hubble.metrics.enableOpenMetrics=true
  hubble.metrics.enabled={dns,drop,tcp,flow,port-distribution,icmp,httpV2}
  tetragon.enabled=true

The k8sServiceHost / k8sServicePort pair is mandatory on K3S: Cilium
cannot reach the API server before kube-proxy exists without it. Put a
comment in the script saying exactly that, because it is the single most
common failure mode and we want the reason recorded next to the code.

Every script must:
- use set -euo pipefail
- be safe to re-run: check state before installing, not just install
- log each action with a "[NN-name]" prefix
- read chart versions from versions.lock and fail if a version is missing

verify-cluster.sh must assert and print a clear pass/fail for:
- cilium agent DaemonSet, all pods ready
- hubble-relay deployed and reachable
- hubble-ui Service exists
- tetragon DaemonSet ready
- `cilium status` exits 0
- kube-proxy is genuinely not running

Acceptance
----------
Run 00, 10, 20, verify-cluster. Then run all four again immediately. The
second run must make no changes and verify-cluster.sh must pass both
times. Report the output of the second run.
